video_caption: Hot Stuff Chilli Grower Plants and Jams are the stuff of myths, produced and grown to outlast empires, survive tsunamis, and power the post-apocalyptic feast.
hero_subheading: Sweet chilli jam, grown and jarred by hand.
story_text:
Welcome to Hot Stuff Urban Farm, a little patch of resilience at the end of the earth. We’re more than just chillies. From fiery peppers to healing roots, from lush greens to exotic fruits, everything we grow is shaped by volcanic soil, salty ocean breezes, and weather that forges plants tough enough to thrive. 

Our chillies have been grown with love, care and attention for over 10 years — and it shows in every jar. Loved by everyone who tries it, our jam starts with heirloom seed varieties, propagated by hand and nurtured using only organic sprays and organic fish fertiliser. No shortcuts, just good soil, good seed, and a lot of patience.
